mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at overcast skies over Fireman's Park with a temperature of 32 degrees that feels like 24. We have a full moon tonight, and although the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Property tax bills will be mailed by December 15th with the first installment due January 31st. Also, candidate registration packets for the 2027 spring election for all four aldermanic districts are now available at the City Clerk's office and must be filed by January 5th.

For local events, you can check out Live Music at Paddy Mac's today, or head to Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory tomorrow. Later this week, do not miss The Crafty Fair on November 28th at ART House 360.
In police news, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue, where a driver was arrested for O W I with a minor in the vehicle.
Over at Culver's, doors open today at 10:00 AM featuring Dark Chocolate Decadence as today's flavor of the day.
